---
# ocp4_workload_tick_replay: market-data tick replay brokers for the replay lab
- name: Create the tick replay namespace
  kubernetes.core.k8s:
    api_version: v1
    kind: Namespace
    name: "tick-replay-{{ guid }}"
    state: present

- name: Pick the PodDisruptionBudget API for this cluster
  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    _tick_replay_pdb_api: "{{ 'policy/v1' if ocp4_cluster_version >= '4.8' else 'policy/v1beta1' }}"

- name: Report the PodDisruptionBudget API
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "PodDisruptionBudget API for OpenShift {{ ocp4_cluster_version }}: {{ _tick_replay_pdb_api }}"

- name: Deploy the replay brokers
  kubernetes.core.k8s:
    state: present
    template: replay-brokers.yaml.j2

- name: Protect the replay brokers
  ansible.builtin.include_tasks: disruption_budget.yml

- name: Pick the PodDisruptionBudget API for this cluster

- name: Report the PodDisruptionBudget API

---
# Keep two of the three replay brokers up through node drains
- name: Create the replay broker disruption budget
  kubernetes.core.k8s:
    state: present
    definition:
      apiVersion: "{{ _tick_replay_pdb_api }}"
      kind: PodDisruptionBudget
      metadata:
        name: tick-replay-brokers
        namespace: "tick-replay-{{ guid }}"
      spec:
        minAvailable: 2
        selector:
          matchLabels:
            app: tick-replay-broker
